## Problem and resulting behavior

State the concrete trigger, previous behavior and resulting behavior. Link the ARB ticket and relevant requirement IDs.

## Evidence

Describe verification performed and attach meaningful output or screenshots. Identify checks that were not run and any remaining acceptance gaps.

## Risk and operation

Describe changes to arithmetic, evidence labels, credentials, lifecycle fences, migrations or recovery where relevant. Include deployment/rollback steps if this changes a deployed service. Planning a live feature does not authorize live funding, arming or signing.
